abilities.name: Avoidance
abilities.description: While moving, Cassia gradually gains up to 30 Armor over 3 seconds. After remaining stationary for 0.75 seconds the Armor is rapidly lost over 0.5 seconds. Avoidance remains charged while Fending.

fields.notes: Grants one stack of Avoidance every 0.0625 seconds, increasing Cassia's Armor by 0.625. While stationary, Cassia loses 6 stacks every 0.0625 seconds. Does not stack with other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

abilities.name: Lightning Fury
abilities.description: Hurl a lightning javelin that deals 158 damage to the first enemy hit and splits into two lightning bolts that deal 158 damage to enemies in their path.; 5 / 1.0

fields.notes: Holds 2 charges. Secondary projectiles do not split and can hit enemies that are immune to skillshots. Otherwise, they have the same on-hit properties as the initial missile and interact with all talents affecting Lightning Fury. Primary target cannot be hit by the splitting secondary bolts.

abilities.name: Blinding Light
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, deal 50 damage and Blind enemies in the target area for 2 seconds. Passive Cassia deals 15% increased damage to Blinded targets.

fields.type: Spell Damage, Status effect / Offensive damage modifier
fields.notes: Passive bonus triggers from all Blinds. Passive bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Cassia's Basic Attack damage.

abilities.name: Fend
abilities.description: Charge at an enemy, and upon arriving channel for 1.5 seconds, dealing 64 damage to enemies in front of Cassia every 0.25 seconds. Deals 50% reduced damage to non-Heroes. Avoidance remains charged while Channeling.; 10 / 0.5

fields.notes: Structures cannot be directly targeted, but can take area damage from Fend. Fend is interrupted if the target moves farther than 12 range from Cassia. Fend 's channel can be canceled after 0.5 seconds by reactivating the ability. Damage penalty against non-Heroes stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Fend 's damage.

abilities.name: Ball Lightning
abilities.description: Throw a ball of lightning at an enemy Hero that bounces up to 6 times between nearby enemy Heroes and Cassia, dealing 180 damage to enemies hit.; 60; 60; heroic

fields.notes: Initial cast is interrupted if the target moves more than 3 units beyond its maximum range. Prioritizes the closest enemy Hero and only bounces back to Cassia if there are no enemy Heroes in its bounce range. Ball Lightning going through Cassia consumes a bounce normally. Cannot bounce to enemies out of vision. Ball Lightning grants vision in 4.0 radius around the projectile.

abilities.name: Valkyrie
abilities.description: Summon a Valkyrie that rushes to Cassia after 0.75 seconds, pulling the first enemy Hero hit, dealing 225 damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds at the end of her path. The Valkyrie knocks back all other enemy Heroes in her way.; 60; 60; heroic

fields.notes: Damage is dealt upon impact, and the Stun is applied when the impaled enemy Hero reaches the cast location. The impaled enemy is Unstoppable while being pulled by Valkyrie. Secondary targets are knocked away perpendicular to Valkyrie 's direction.

talents.name: Thunderstroke
talents.description: Increase the damage of Lightning Fury by 20. Questonly Lightning Fury's damage is increased by 1.5 every time it hits a Hero.
_raw_fields: Increase the damage of Lightning Fury by 20. Questonly Lightning Fury's damage is increased by 1.5 every time it hits a Hero.

talents.name: Impale
talents.description: Increase Fend's cast range and area of effect by 25%. It deals an additional 70% damage to enemies below 50% Health.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Fend 's damage.

_raw_fields: Increase Fend's cast range and area of effect by 25%. It deals an additional 70% damage to enemies below 50% Health.

talents.name: Charged Strikes
talents.description: Gain 15% Attack Speed. Every 3rd Basic Attack deals 20% bonus damage and bounces to nearby enemy Heroes.

fields.notes: Bounce radius is extended by the target's unit radius. Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Cassia's Basic Attack damage. Still progresses through the 3-hit cycle if Cassia is Blinded or the target is Evading, though the 3rd hit bonus will also miss entirely in that case.

_raw_fields: Gain 15% Attack Speed. Every 3rd Basic Attack deals 20% bonus damage and bounces to nearby enemy Heroes.

talents.name: Plate of the Whale
talents.description: Regenerate 6 Health per second while Avoidance is active. If fully charged gain an additional 12 Health per second.

talents.name: Ring of the Leech
talents.description: Basic Attacks against your primary target heal you for 20% of their damage. If an enemy is Blinded, this also affects Lightning Fury and Fend.
_raw_fields: Basic Attacks against your primary target heal you for 20% of their damage. If an enemy is Blinded, this also affects Lightning Fury and Fend.

talents.name: Inner Light
talents.description: Cooldown 70 Activate to heal for 25% of your maximum Health over 5 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit by Lightning Fury lower the cooldown of this ability by 10 seconds.
_raw_fields: Cooldown 70 Activate to heal for 25% of your maximum Health over 5 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit by Lightning Fury lower the cooldown of this ability by 10 seconds.

talents.name: Seraph's Hymn
talents.description: Primary Basic Attacks against an enemy Hero grant 10 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Blinding Light by 2 seconds. Passive Increase the passive damage bonus of Blinding Light from 15% to 30%.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other damage modifiers affecting Cassia's Basic Attack damage output, including baseline bonus damage against Blinded targets.

talents.name: Power Strike
talents.description: Lightning Fury pierces, but only splits on Heroes. Enemy Heroes hit reduce its cooldown by 1 second and become marked for 15 seconds. Upon reaching 3 marks, remove the marks and cast a Blinding Light at their feet.

fields.notes: Reapplying a mark refreshes its duration.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Blind, Root, Silence
